Data coverage, model & validation

Red-card validation · 18 October 2026

A candidate using dismissed side, dismissal timing, counts and score interactions was tested on 433 held-out red-card matches (1,192 states). Brier error: baseline 0.22310; candidate 0.22015. The 95% match-cluster bootstrap interval for the difference was −0.00712 to +0.00110, so a reliable improvement was not established. Recorded cards also need verification against on-pitch player status. Red-card predictions remain withheld; no fixed probability uplift is applied.

What the estimate uses

Only the selected league and years. Historical states match the current score difference (differences of three or more grouped together). Matching total goals receives twice the weight; totals of five or more are grouped. Matching either team in its home/away role adds weight, up to 3× for both. The weighted rate is shrunk toward the league's same-minute average with 10 effective observations. Team differences are modest adjustments, not individually fitted team forecasts.

Recorded goal minutes are treated as completed-minute boundaries: a goal recorded at 80 is already included at 80:00; later goals are future outcomes. Minute-level data cannot resolve seconds within a minute. Use 80:00–89:00 only. Second-half stoppage-time goals are included; extra time and shootouts are excluded. Matches with a red card before the selected minute are excluded from the comparison pool.

The calculator does not observe possession, shots, substitutions, injuries, added time, VAR reviews, market suspension or a live feed. Wait until score and market settlement state are confirmed. Argentina and Liga MX pool their eligible league/group phases within each calendar year.

Validation trains on 2021–2024 and evaluates 2025 at minutes 80, 85 and 89, excluding states after a red card. This tests equal-year weighting, not every selectable season/weighting configuration. Brier score is probability error: lower is better. No bookmaker-price backtest or profitability result is available.
